verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              ततो निवातकवचाः सर्वे वेगेन भारत। अभ्यद्रवन् मां सहिताः प्रगृहीतायुधा रणे॥१॥
verses.english: Arjuna said: Then, O Bharata, furnished with arms, all the Nivatakavacha flew in a body towards me furiously in battle,

verses.sanskrit: आच्छाद्य रथपन्थानमुत्क्रोशन्तो महारथाः। आवृत्य सर्वतस्त मां शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥२॥
verses.english: Those mighty car-warriors obstructing the course of the car and uttering loud yells and surrounding me on all sides, enveloped me with downpours of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽपरे महावीर्याः शूलपट्टिशपाणयः। शूलानि च भुशुण्डीश्च मुमुचुर्दानवा मयि॥३॥
verses.english: Then other demons, of great strength armed with spears and Pattishas, hurled at me spears and Bhushundis.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुलवर्षं सुमहद्गदाशक्तिसमाकुलम्। अनिशं सृज्यमानं तैरपतन्मद्र‌थोपरि॥४॥
verses.english: That continuous discharge of spears together with maces and clubs fell upon my car.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये मामभ्यधावन्त निवातकवचा युधि। जितशस्त्रायुधा रौद्राः कालरूपाः प्रहारिणः॥५॥
verses.english: Other dreadful and terrible-looking Nivatakavachas, dexterous in hurling (weapons) and armed with sharpened weapons and bows, rushed at me in fight.

verses.sanskrit: तानहं विविधैर्बाणैवैगवद्भिरजिह्मगैः। गाण्डीवमुक्तैरभ्यघ्नमेकैकं दशभिर्मुधे॥६॥
verses.english: I (on my part) in the encounter, discharging several fleet arrows coursing straight, from the Gandiva, pierced each of them with ten (shafts).

verses.sanskrit: ते कृता विमुखाः सर्वे मत्प्रयुक्तैः शिलाशितैः। ततो मातलिना तूर्णं हयास्ते सम्प्रचोदिताः॥७॥
verses.english: (And) I drove them back by those arrows of mine sharpened on stones. Then those horses being swiftly driven by Matali,

verses.sanskrit: मार्गान् बहुविधांस्तत्र विचेरुर्वातरंहसः। सुसंयता मातलिना प्रामथ्नन्त दितेः सुतान्॥८॥
verses.english: Careered through several courses with the spread of the wind and being dexterously guided by Matali, trampled upon the sons of Diti.

verses.sanskrit: शतं शतास्ते हरयस्तस्मिन् युक्ता महारथे। शान्ता मातलिना यत्ता व्यचरन्नल्पका इव॥९॥
verses.english: (And) Though that mighty car was yoked with hundreds of horses, yet being skillfully driven by Matali, as they began to move, it seemed as if they were a few only.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां चरणपातेन रथनेमिस्वनेन च। मम बाणनिपातैश्च हतास्ते शतशोऽसुराः॥१०॥
verses.english: By the press of their hoofs and by the thundering noise of the car-wheels and by the discharge of my arrows hundreds of demons fell dead.
verses.bhavadeepa: शताः शतानि अयुतमित्यर्थः । हरयोऽश्वाः । शान्ताः परीक्षिताः । शमेरालोचनार्थान्निष्ठा ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: गतासवस्तथैवाऽन्ये प्रगृहीतशरासनाः। हतसारथयस्तत्र व्यकृष्यन्त तुरंगमैः॥११॥
verses.english: Others, holding their bows in their hands, even when deprived of life and their charioteers being slain, were carried (hither and thither) by the horses.

verses.sanskrit: ते दिशो विदिशः सर्वे प्रतिरुथ्य प्रहारिणः। अभ्यघ्नन् विविधैः शस्त्रस्ततो मे व्यथितं मनः॥१२॥
verses.english: (And) all those dexterous in striking, obstructing all sides and directions, became engaged in the fight with various weapons, at which my mind was distressed.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहं मातलेर्वीर्यमपश्यं परमाद्भुतम्। अश्वांस्तथा वेगवतो यदयत्ना‌दधारयत्॥१३॥
verses.english: Then the prowess of Matali appeared highly wonderful to me in that he guided the swift steeds with ease.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहं लघुभिश्चित्रैरस्त्रैस्तानसुरान् रणे। चिच्छेद सायुधान् राजन् शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥१४॥
verses.english: O king, then, in the fight, I cut off the Danavas by hundreds and thousands who were furnished with arms, by various swift weapons.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मे चरतस्तत्र सर्वयत्नेन शत्रुहन्। प्रीतिमानभवद्वीरो मातलिः शक्रसारथिः॥१५॥
verses.english: O destroyer of foes, the heroic charioteer of Shakra, Matali, seeing me thus course there (on the field of battle) exerting my utmost, became well pleased (with me).
verses.bhavadeepa: चिच्छेद अहमिति शेषः । परोक्षार्थलिट्प्रयोगेण अजानतैव मया एतत् कृतमिति शत्रूणामत्यन्तापकर्षः सूचितः ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: वध्यमानास्ततस्तैस्तु हयैस्तेन रथेन च। अगमन् प्रक्षयं केचिन्न्यवर्तन्त तथा परे॥१६॥
verses.english: Then, some (of the Danavas) crushed by the horses and the car, met with destruction and some gave up fighting; while others, in the encounter, challenged by us and afflicted with arrows, opposed me by heavy downpour of shafts.

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्धमाना इवास्माभिर्निवातकवचा रणे। शरवर्षैः शरार्तं मां महद्भिः प्रत्यवारयन्॥१७॥
ततोऽहं लघुभिश्चित्रैर्ब्रह्मास्त्रपरिमन्त्रितैः। व्यधमं सायकैराशु शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥१८॥
verses.english: Thereupon, I began to consume them with hundreds and thousands of ornamented swift arrows inspired with Mantras relating to the weapon of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सम्पीड्यमानास्ते क्रोधाविष्टा महारथाः। अपीडयन् मां सहिताः शक्तिशूलासिवृष्टिभिः॥१९॥
verses.english: Then those mighty demons sore pressed by me and fired with anger, afflicted me with simultaneous discharge of clubs, darts and swords.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहमस्त्रमातिष्ठं परमं तिग्मतैजसम्। दयितं देवराजस्य माधवं नाम भारत॥२०॥
verses.english: O Bharata, I then, took up that favourite weapon of the lord of the gods, named, Madhava, possessed of exceedingly fiery energy.

verses.sanskrit: ततः खड्गत्रिशूलेन तोमरांश्च सहस्रशः। अस्त्रवीर्येण शतधा तैर्मुक्तानहमच्छिदम्॥२१॥
verses.english: Then by the power of that weapon, I cut, to a hundred pieces, the swords, tridents and thousands of Tomaras hurled by them.
verses.bhavadeepa: तिग्मतैजसं तीक्ष्णदाहकम् । माधवं नाम मधोर्दैत्यस्य वधार्थं निर्मितत्वात् ॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वा प्रहरणान्येषां ततस्तानपि सर्वशः। प्रत्यविध्यमहं रोषाद्दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः॥२२॥
verses.english: Having destroyed their weapons, wrathfully pierced each of them with ten arrows.
verses.bhavadeepa: ततो माधवास्त्रात् उत्पन्नेन खड्गसहितेन त्रिशूलेन । खड्गांश्च शूलांश्चेति पाठे शरैरित्युत्तरश्लोकादपकर्षणीयम् ॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: गाण्डीवाद्धि तदा संख्ये यथा भ्रमरपङ्क्तयः। निष्पतन्ति महाबाणास्तन्मातलिरपूजयत्॥२३॥
verses.english: And the fact that on the battle field mighty arrows like (thick flights of black bees), were discharged from the Gandiva, was admired by Matali.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामपि तु बाणास्ते तन्मातलिरपूजयत्। अवाकिरन् मां बलवत्तानहं व्यधमं शरैः॥२४॥
verses.english: And the skillfulness with which displaying prowess, I cut off, with my shafts, their arrows which completely surrounded me, drew admiration from Matali.

verses.sanskrit: वध्यमानास्ततस्ते तु निवातकवचाः पुनः। शरवर्षैर्महद्भिर्मां समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥२५॥
verses.english: Being struck, those Nivatakavachas again completely surrounded me with a mighty discharge of arrows.
verses.bhavadeepa: तेषां ते बाणाः माम् अवाकिरन्निति सम्बन्धः । तदपि मातलिरपूजयत् ॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: शरवेगान्निहत्याहमस्त्रैरस्त्रविघातिभिः। ज्वलद्भिः परमैः शीघैस्तानविध्यं सहस्रशः॥२६॥
verses.english: Having arrested the career of their shafts by excellent, fleet and blazing weapons inspired with mantras, capable of destroying (other) weapons, I pierced them by thousands.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां छिन्नानि गात्राणि विसृजन्ति स्म शोणितम्। प्रावृषीवाभिवृष्टानि शृङ्गाण्यथ धराभृताम्॥२७॥
verses.english: Like waters running down from the summit of mountains, in the rainy season, blood began to flow from their mangled bodies.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शैर्वेगवद्भिरजिह्मगैः। मद्बाणैर्वध्यमानास्ते समुद्विग्नाः स्म दानवाः॥२८॥
verses.english: Smitten by mighty, fleet and straightcoursing arrows having the touch of the thunderbolt hurled by Indra, those Danavas became greatly agitated.

verses.sanskrit: शतधा भिन्नदेहास्ते क्षीणप्रहरणौजसः। ततो निवातकवचा मामयुध्यन्त मायया॥२९॥
verses.english: Their bodies were cut to a hundred pieces and their weapons lost their energy. Then those Nivatakavachas began fighting with me by the help of illusion.
